[[File:12.Saeimas deputāts Guntis Belēvičs (15978533706).jpg|thumb|Guntis Belēvičs in 2014]]
'''Guntis Belēvičs''' (born September 2, 1958<ref name="Personal page">{{cite web|author1=Guntis Belēvičs|title=Biogrāfija|url=http://www.belevics.lv/par-gunti/biografija/|website=Dr. Guntis Belēvičs|accessdate=12 June 2016|language=lv|date=2013}}</ref>) is a [[Latvia]]n politician, who was Minister of Health in the [[second Straujuma cabinet|second Straujuma]] and [[Kučinskis cabinet|Kučinskis]] cabinets from 2014 to 2016.<ref name="Scandal">{{cite news|title=Scandal-mired health minister quits|url=https://www.lsm.lv/en/article/politics/scandal-mired-health-minister-quits.a187083/|accessdate=12 June 2016|publisher=[[Public Broadcasting of Latvia]]|date=10 June 2016}}</ref>
